name.cite: EDM 2026 §9.3.4.1 Table 9-3 p.351, row 8, column Medium Trees

table_9_3.note: "Tree size classifications are approximate and intended as guidelines" (p.352); Columnar is never assigned from this table

city.match_rule: genus == PARROTIA and first species word == PERSICA; hybrid marker 'X' ignored; any cultivar

height_m.note: City height_m values are class midpoints (4.6, 7.6, 10.7 …), not measurements

form.note: assigned by the author from horticultural common knowledge; replaced when a cited reference is entered

literature.source: City of Vancouver Street Tree Guidelines 2011, pp.12–14
literature.definition_as_printed: Trees maturing between twenty-five (25) and fifty (50) feet are generally suitable for situating on a blockside tree lawn three (3) feet or greater between curb and sidewalk.
literature.note: a class threshold, not a per-species value: the drawn crown still uses the nominal ratio; the only width the City prints is 'over 25 ft' for Large

crown_width.note: crown spread is not published by the City; ratio by form (round .6, oval .5, vase .7, columnar .3, conical .45, weeping .8) until a cited value replaces it; Guidelines 2011 give only a class threshold (see literature), so the ratio stays nominal

root_form.note: root habit for the drawing only: roots are drawn to fill the soil the rule credits and are cut where the black or a clearance begins; never a measured extent
root_form.atlas_note: no plate of this species or genus in the WUR root atlas (searched 2026-09-28)

guidelines_2011.cite: City of Vancouver Street Tree Guidelines 2011, Preferred Street Tree Species List pp.12–14 (Columnar, Medium)

class_definitions.Medium: Trees maturing between twenty-five (25) and fifty (50) feet are generally suitable for situating on a blockside tree lawn three (3) feet or greater between curb and sidewalk.
class_definitions.Columnar: Trees exhibiting a distinct upright branch arrangement. Suitable for locating in confined situations or on tree lawns offset from overhead electrical conductors.

guidelines_2011.note: a 2011 City guideline list (species-level cultivars as printed); EDM 2026 Table 9-3 is the rule the tool applies

drawn_height_m.basis: p90 of City height_m over 3005 trees of this species
drawn_height_m.note: nine in ten City trees of this species are this tall or shorter; class midpoints, not a mature size

section.source: V-10880 (2819 W 11th Av, Kitsilano) front boulevard under R30, an ordinary 20 m residential section; reference only

need_box_in_library.note: reference only; on a site the box takes the site's band section

model.note: trunk cylinder + faceted crown hull, no branching; normalized to height 1.0 and scaled by the tree's height on the page
